import pixeltable as pxt
from pixeltable.functions.huggingface import sentence_transformer

t = pxt.get_table("docs")

embed_fn = sentence_transformer.using(model_id="all-MiniLM-L6-v2")
t.add_embedding_index(t.content, embedding=embed_fn, if_exists="ignore")

sim = t.content.similarity(string="climate change policy")
results = (
    t.select(t.content, sim=sim)
    .order_by(sim, asc=False)
    .limit(5)
    .collect()
)

print(results)
